Title: The Popular Must-Try Muscovy Duck Specialties of Kudus | Main ke Kudus
URL: https://mainkekudus.com/en/news/laris-manis-aneka-olahan-entok-kudus-yang-wajib-kamu-coba
Published: 2026-10-17T13:11:47.000Z
Author: Saldy Nurzaman
Highlights:
Published: 17 October 2026 Author: Saldy Nurzaman

KUDUS – Muscovy duck (entok) dishes in Kudus Regency are prepared in a variety of styles, ranging from fried, braised (bacem), and satay to swike (soup-style) and smoked. Prices range from IDR 25,000 to IDR 32,000 per portion, offering options to suit any palate or budget.

Each eatery maintains its own specialty. Some serve fried duck with fresh bird's eye chili sambal, while others focus on sweet and savory spice blends or fermented soybean (tauco) broth. Variations in menus, operating hours, and locations are worth noting before visiting.

Below are seven recommended Muscovy duck eateries in Kudus, including signature dishes, pricing, addresses, and visitor information.

...

Warung Makan Entok Goreng Bu Eni is located at Desa Prambatan Kidul No. 10, Karang Wetan, Kaliwungu District, Kudus Regency.

...

## 2. Pak Badi's Muscovy Duck Restaurant in Pasuruhan Lor

...

Warung Makan Entok Pak Badi is located on Jalan Ganesa, Gang Murai, Pasuruhan Lor Village, Jati District, Kudus Regency. The eatery is open daily from 9:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. local time.

...

## 3. Warung Makan Entog Om W in Bacin

...

Warung Makan Entog Om W specializes in fried Muscovy duck prepared using the traditional bacem method. Established in 2017, the eatery offers a sweet and savory flavor profile that distinguishes it from conventional salted, savory fried duck dishes.

...

The fried bacem duck is priced at Rp25,000 per portion, which includes all-you-can-eat rice. Customers seeking a milder heat can opt for the shrimp paste sambal, which is also available.

...

Warung Makan Entog Om W is located on Jalan Kapten Ali Mahmudi, Bacin Village, Bae District, Kudus. The establishment is open daily from 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. WIB.

...

## 4. Warung Makan Entok Pak Teguh in Payaman

...

Visitors seeking soup-based dishes can find options at Warung Makan Entok Pak Teguh, located in Payaman Village, Mejobo District. A signature offering is swike entok, which features Muscovy duck meat served in a savory fermented soy bean (tauco) broth.

The establishment has been serving customers for 17 years.

...

A portion of swike entok is priced at Rp30,000. In addition to the soup, the menu includes rica-rica entok (spicy stir-fried duck) and fried duck.

...

Warung Makan Entok Pak Teguh is located on the South Ring Road in Payaman Village, Mejobo District, Kudus Regency. It is open daily from 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. WIB, making it a viable option for breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

...

## 5. Kudus Smoked Entok Restaurant in Jepangpakis

...

The Kudus Smoked Entok Restaurant offers diners a unique culinary experience featuring smoked Muscovy duck.

...

Each portion of smoked duck is priced at Rp30,000.

...

The Enthog Asap Jepang Kudus restaurant is located at Gang Langgar Domas I, Krajan Kidul, Jepangpakis Village, Jati District, Kudus Regency. The restaurant is open daily and offers ample parking space. Operating hours have not yet been specified, so visitors are advised to confirm before arriving.

...

## 6. Warung Makan Entok Mbak Hesti in Pasuruhan Lor

(Photo: jmy/mainkekudus)

Warung Makan Entok Mbak Hesti features two signature dishes: fried Muscovy duck (entok goreng) and spicy Muscovy duck curry (tongseng entok). Established in 2019, the restaurant prepares the meat by cleaning and boiling it with spices before further cooking.

The fried duck is served with a savory, salty profile accompanied by fresh bird's eye chili sambal. Meanwhile, the tongseng entok offers a spicy, sweet flavor with an adjustable heat level.

Owner Hesti Wulandari noted that dinner is typically the busiest time of day.

Hesti Wulandari, owner of Warung Makan Entok Mbak Hesti. (Photo: jmy/mainkekudus)

"We have cooked it that way since the beginning. The duck is cleaned and then boiled. We are usually busiest during dinner time, which is why I have staff here to help," Hesti said.

The fried duck package is priced at IDR 26,000, including rice and a jumbo-sized hot or iced tea. The tongseng entok package costs IDR 30,000, also including rice and a jumbo tea. Rice is served buffet-style.

(Photo: jmy/mainkekudus)

The establishment processes approximately 30 to 35 Muscovy ducks per day, with demand peaking on weekends.

...

Warung Makan Entok Mbak Hesti is located in Pasuruhan Lor Village, Jati District, Kudus Regency. The eatery is open daily from 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM WIB, though food supplies sometimes run out before closing time.

...

## 7. Warung Makan Raja Entog in Prambatan Kidul

(Photo: jmy/mainkekudus)

For late-night diners, Warung Makan Raja Entog in Prambatan Kidul Village, Kaliwungu District, Kudus Regency, has been serving fried duck since 1985. The restaurant maintains a focused menu featuring fried duck served with raw sambal.

Owner Bambang stated that the traditional spice blend and a multi-hour boiling process have remained central to the preparation since the business began. This method ensures the meat is savory and eliminates any gamey odor.

Bambang, owner of Warung Makan Raja Entog. (Photo: jmy/mainkekudus)

“I have been selling duck since the beginning, and the recipe has never changed. Customers often say that the savory flavor of the duck pairs perfectly with the sambal. That is why so many people keep coming back,” Bambang said.

Although the menu is limited to fried Muscovy duck, this eatery manages to sell approximately 60 birds per day. Operating in the evening from 7:00 p.m. to 11:00 p.m. WIB, the restaurant often runs out of stock by 9:00 p.m., just two hours after opening.

...

One serving of fried Muscovy duck is priced at Rp30,000. The eatery is open Monday through Saturday and closed on Sundays.

Raja Entog is located on Jalan Raya Kudus–Jepara Km 5, Prambatan Kidul Village, Kaliwungu District, Kudus Regency. Situated along the main road, it is about 100 meters west of the Prambatan gas station. Patrons planning to dine here should arrive early, as stock frequently sells out before closing time.

Here are solid dinner picks in Kudus, Central Java:

**Local specialties**
- **Sate Kerbau 57** – Jl. Kutilang No.1, Wergu Kulon; famous buffalo satay, open 3–10pm.
- **Raja Entog** – Jl. Raya Kudus–Jepara Km5; legendary fried Muscovy duck, 6:30–11pm, often sells out by 9pm.
- **Soto Kudus Bu Jatmi** – Jl. KH Wahid Hasim No.43; classic soto kerbau/ayam, open till 10pm.

**Casual & family-friendly**
- **Ayam Bakar Gang Telu** (Jl. Kenari No.40, 4.7★) and **Warung Sate Ayam Cak Sony** (Jl. Kepodang No.47, 4.7★, 5–10:30pm).
- **Mie Ayam & Bakso Sugeng Rawuh** – Jl. Bhakti No.30, open till 11pm.

**Sit-down restaurants**
- **Ikki Resto** (Jl. Pangeran Puger, Pan-Asian, 11am–9pm) and **Omah Djadoel Resto** (Javanese/western, 10am–9pm).
- **King Salman Arabic & Indian Food** – Jl. Dr. Ramelan No.19B, 4.9★, open till 8pm.

Check hours before going, as some spots close early or sell out.
